newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat mainly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat mainly unchanged.

text.p: Argentine 1996/97 wheat was mainly unchanged in low volume cash market trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, as farmers busy with harvesting spent less time selling and supply dried up, traders said.

March wheat held firm at $134, prices paid to farmers. April cash maize shed $2 to $93 in middling turnover, with the benign climate sitting on prices. Cash soybeans and sunflower seed lost ground in slow trade, depressed by lower Chicago soybean prices. Bearish factors included good local crop weather and U.S. soy supply. May soybeans tripped down $2 to $233. March sunflower seed lost $3 to $211.
